end.summary:
Practised how a freely suspended magnet settles roughly north-south.
Practised using a compass to identify east and west.
Mahi answered both compass-direction attempts unaided correctly.
Mahi said the compass needle points north because the north is cold; this was not corrected later.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Mahi practised finding directions with a freely suspended magnet and a compass. They used the compass needle and the marked directions to identify east and west correctly. One mix-up was that the needle points north because it is cold; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Mahi to observe a compass away from metal objects and explain that the needle aligns roughly north-south because of Earth’s magnetic field.
